name: universal-builder
//productName: Electron reads this for app.getName(), which is what names the menu bar and the userData folder. Without it both fall back to `name` and the app calls itself universal-builder.
description: Universal Builder -- one application replacing AERS Autobuilder v2.5 and the AERS-Autobuilder beta.
author: Charles Pollaers

scripts.//build: Package the bootstrap. Almost nothing changes here -- the .app is a loader, and day-to-day changes ship through publish:external instead.
scripts.test: node tests/golden/golden.js && node tests/layouts/layouts.js && node tests/brief-errors.js
scripts.//publish:external: Push external/ to the shared folder every installed app reads from. Runs the golden tests first and refuses to publish on an unexpected diff. Always run publish:external:dry first.

//build-config: external/ is deliberately NOT packaged -- see docs/adr/0001-engine-runs-outside-the-app-bundle.md. node_modules IS, because the external tree resolves its packages from the app's copy over NODE_PATH.
